rationale: Although the stock is showing strong downside continuation below the prior day's low of $28.98 on 4.68x relative volume, price has already dropped nearly $3.00 in the first six minutes of trading and sits more than $1.00 below VWAP ($28.83). Chasing a short at the bottom of the opening drive offers poor risk-reward against logical resistance levels, while buying into expanding sell volume lacks any reversal structure. Waiting for a pullback toward the $28.80-$29.00 zone or a tighter consolidation near the lows is required before committing capital.
